option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and imaging findings are consistent with lipoblastoma, a rare benign tumor composed of immature fat cells.
The description of a fatty-appearing, well-circumscribed mass is also consistent with lipoma, a common benign tumor composed of mature fat cells.
Myxoid liposarcoma is a malignant tumor that does not match the clinical presentation and imaging findings.
Teratoma or dermoid cyst is a distinct clinical entity that does not match the description of a fatty-appearing mass.
Involuting hemangioma is a vascular lesion that does not match the clinical presentation and imaging findings.
Hibernoma is a rare benign tumor that does not match the clinical presentation and imaging findings.
None is not a valid diagnosis.
